Definition
[Boundary barriers] 1. ch14:14.2\group ch14-boundary-gradient For the comparison argument, consider \begin{equation} Qu=a^{ij}(x,Du)D_{ij}u+b(x,u,Du), \tag {14.2} \end{equation} where $b$ is nonincreasing in its scalar argument. Let $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C^0(\overline\Omega )$ solve $Qu=0$. At $x_0\in \partial \Omega $, upper and lower barriers are functions $w^\pm \in C^2(\mathcal N\cap \Omega )\cap C^1(\mathcal N\cap \overline\Omega )$ such that \[ \pm Qw^\pm <0\text{ in }\mathcal N\cap \Omega ,\qquad w^\pm (x_0)=u(x_0),\qquad w^-\leq u\leq w^+\text{ on }\partial (\mathcal N\cap \Omega ). \]
